title: The Cash | Walk to Broadway | Pool | Balcony
description:
♫ Walk the Line to Comfort in Johnny Cash-Themed Downtown Studio w/ Balcony ♫

Welcome to your Nashville getaway! This stylish, Johnny Cash-themed studio is located in the heart of Downtown Nashville—just minutes from Broadway, Honky Tonks, and all the action Music City has to offer. Whether you’re here for the music, food, or fun, you’ll be staying in a space as legendary as The Man in Black himself.

The space
🛏️ Studio Features:

- Sleeps up to 4 guests comfortably (1 king bed + 1 queen sleeper sofa)

- Private Balcony to enjoy your morning coffee or evening nightcap

- Full Kitchen + Washer/Dryer

- Fast Wi-Fi & Smart TV

- Complimentary Starter Items (detergent, dishwasher pods, toiletries, etc.)

- Curated Johnny Cash decor and vintage touches throughout

🏢 Building Amenities:

- Resort-style heated saltwater pool

- Fully equipped fitness center / gym

- Modern coworking spaces for remote work

- Rooftop BBQ grills and outdoor seating with skyline views

- Inviting gathering spaces perfect for relaxing or socializing

LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!
★ 5 Min Walk to Convention Center
★ 6 Min Walk to Bridgestone Arena
★ 8 Min Walk to the Broadway strip
★ 10 Min Walk to The Ryman
★ 10 Min Walk to Fifth + Broad Dining/Shops

★ 3 Min Ride to Ascend Amphitheatre
★ 4 Min Ride to Nissan Stadium
★ 10 Min Ride to BNA

🎶 Whether you're a die-hard Cash fan or just want a memorable stay in Music City, this is the perfect crash pad for couples, friends, or small families.

Book now and make your stay legendary!
“Because you're mine... I walk the line.”

You will have access to the entire apartment. You will also have access to all shared building amenities such as the pool, gym, gathering spaces, and other common areas as long as they are not closed for maintenance.

While we do our best to notify guests of common area/amenity closures, maintenance and other unavailability issues it is out of our control. Refunds are not issued for unavailable amenities. 

** PARKING: We have a reserved parking spot in the attached parking garage for $30/night. You can purchase this via host prior to your arrival and it will be paid separately from your Airbnb reservation. Let us know if you would like to add parking! **
